fields.name: unused_head
fields.meaning: never written; always zero from power-on
fields.evidence: zero in every save image; no code reference

fields.name: cast_table
fields.meaning: 32 character cards (0x8C bytes each) for the people in the cases; rebuilt from the cartridge's built-in table at every data reset, so the content is fixed text, not progress; same card layout as below
fields.evidence: written in the opening; bodies byte-identical to ROM table at file offset 0x21D3D4; copy routine 2000:345E

fields.name: unused_gap
fields.meaning: 128-byte padding between the cast table (ends 0x1F80) and the profile slots (start 0x2000); never written
fields.evidence: zero in every save image; fill/copy in 2000:345E end at 0x1F80

fields.name: profile_slots
fields.meaning: 21 profile cards (0x8C bytes each): slots 0-19 are friends' cards, slot 20 (0x2AF0) is the player's own card; empty slots are all FF
fields.evidence: area formatted to FF in the opening by 2000:C940; slot 20 filled on register; slot counts 0x14/0x15 in code

fields.name: unused_mid
fields.meaning: zero in every save image; no code reference
fields.evidence: zero in every save image; code scan

fields.name: suspend_snapshot
fields.meaning: quick-save copy of the game work memory (RAM 0x0100-0x03FF); restored at power-on only if the marker at 0x63F0 is valid
fields.evidence: copy RAM->save 2000:43FA then marker write, restore 2000:4414, boot check 2000:43E2/45C7; all zero in saves (no suspend made)

fields.name: unused_snap_tail
fields.meaning: zero; cleared together with the snapshot area by the data reset

fields.name: best_records
fields.meaning: 30 best-result words for timed/scored games (index = game number - 12); a new result (frame counter / 75, i.e. seconds) replaces the stored one only if it is higher; FFFF = no record
fields.evidence: set to FFFF by reset 2000:4CB3; writer 2000:938C keeps the maximum, reader 2000:8CEC

fields.name: unknown_63ac
fields.meaning: zero, no access found
fields.evidence: code scan

fields.name: colour_hw_flag
fields.meaning: 1 when the game runs on a WonderSwan Color, 0 on a mono WonderSwan; rewritten at every start-up
fields.evidence: 0->1 entering Color mode; code 2000:0111 (port 0xA0 bit 1)

fields.name: story_flags
fields.meaning: event flags set by the scenario script (flag array 0x63B0 + n, value 0/1)
fields.evidence: script command 2000:1445 stores 0/1; all zero in saves

fields.name: case_files_open
fields.meaning: one byte per case file 1-10: bit 0 set = file is listed on the FILE selection screen
fields.evidence: 0x63B4 0->1 when case 1 opened, FILE1 shown; setter 2000:0AB1, 10-byte list loop 2000:0A3F, cleared by 2000:393F

fields.name: minigame_flags
fields.meaning: availability flags for the minigame menus: a game is listed only when its flag is non-zero
fields.evidence: tested at 2000:8A2C/8AE8/8F64 before listing; settable by the script command 2000:1445

fields.name: unknown_63c0
fields.meaning: zero, no access found
fields.evidence: code scan

fields.name: case_ranks
fields.meaning: best detective rank per case: 0 = A ... 5 = F (5 = no rank yet); shown after the file name as letter 0xAD+rank; only a better (lower) rank replaces the stored one
fields.evidence: set to 05 x 12 by 2000:393F; FILE1:F on screen = 0xAD+5; reader 2000:0A0D, minimum-keeping writer 2000:0353

fields.name: unknown_63dc
fields.meaning: zero, no access found
fields.evidence: code scan

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: save signature ASCII 'WONDERSWANCONAN3'; if it does not match (or the own card is empty) the game treats the memory as blank and runs the first-time setup
fields.evidence: written by 2000:439A from ROM; compared at power-on by 2000:43B2; second compare vs 'WONDERSWANCONAN2' at 2000:43CA after a link transfer

fields.name: suspend_marker
fields.meaning: copy of the same signature written after a suspend snapshot; valid = snapshot at 0x6000 is restored at power-on; first byte zeroed by the data reset to invalidate it
fields.evidence: writer 2000:4382, check 2000:43E2, invalidate 2000:345E/0CAC; zero in saves

fields.name: stamp_grid
fields.meaning: 7 x 6 grid of one-byte entries (FF = empty cell) on a notebook page that is not the calendar; cell index = row*7+col from the page cursor
fields.evidence: store/read/clear/draw 2000:CE22/CE62/CEFC/D148; calendar stamp placement writes 0x6600 instead and leaves this grid untouched

fields.name: unknown_642a
fields.meaning: FF fill from the opening format; no access found
fields.evidence: format 2000:C95C fills 0x6400-0x7FFF

fields.name: calendar_marks
fields.meaning: 1024 calendar stamps of 5 bytes: year (u16), month, day, stamp id; first word FFFF = free entry
fields.evidence: writer 2000:D4E1 (overwrite same date, else first free) + natural save: stamp on 2001-04-08 wrote D1 07 04 08 03, visible on the calendar screen

fields.name: calendar_memos
fields.meaning: 32 memo entries of 34 bytes: year (u16), month, day, 30 bytes of memo text; FFFF = free entry
fields.evidence: writer 2000:E334 (first free, text from RAM 0x1900), search 2000:E49F; FF in saves

fields.name: unknown_7e40
fields.meaning: FF fill from the opening format; no access found
fields.evidence: format 2000:C95C

fields.name: calendar_page
fields.meaning: calendar page last set: year (u16, 2001 used when FFFF/0/>9999) and month (u8, April used when 0/>12)
fields.evidence: read with defaults 2000:DA29, written from the cursor date 2000:DA6E; fresh notebook shows April 2001
